fichas.title: High-rise building construction and structural systems
fichas.summary: High-rise design is shaped by the structural system, vertical access, horizontal wind forces, and the space and cost implications of increasing height. Steel or reinforced-concrete frames are standard, with slab spans and suitable structural systems varying by construction type and building height. Sky lobbies can reduce lift space and travel time. The John Hancock Center illustrates a tube structure and a layered mix of uses.
